# YTCE project-internal JDownloader vendor area

This folder is the project-local JDownloader subsystem boundary for YTCE.

The committed files are lightweight scripts, manifests, bridge source, and
license/provenance notes. Heavy copied source archives, extracted source trees,
and runtime files are generated by the bootstrap scripts and are ignored by git
until packaging rules are finalized.

## Rules

- The installed JDownloader app under the user profile is a bootstrap source
  only. Once `third_party/jdownloader/runtime/JDownloader 2/` exists, YTCE
  treats that project-internal runtime as the preferred runtime.
- YTCE must not silently hand a URL to the user's separately opened external
  JDownloader GUI as the primary solution.
- `yt-dlp` remains a fallback backend only.
- Upstream provenance and license boundaries must be preserved in generated
  manifests.

## Bootstrap

```cmd
tools\jdownloader\BOOTSTRAP_JDOWNLOADER_VENDOR.cmd --source-only
tools\jdownloader\BOOTSTRAP_JDOWNLOADER_VENDOR.cmd --source-and-runtime
tools\jdownloader\BOOTSTRAP_JDOWNLOADER_VENDOR.cmd --source-only --extract-source
tools\jdownloader\VERIFY_JDOWNLOADER_VENDOR.cmd
```

## Bridge

The bridge source in `bridge/src/ytce/jdbridge/` compiles independently first.
It provides a real CLI/probe/manifest boundary that can later call into
JDownloader internals.

```cmd
tools\jdownloader\BUILD_INTERNAL_JDOWNLOADER_RUNTIME.cmd
tools\jdownloader\RUN_INTERNAL_JDOWNLOADER_PROBE.cmd
```
